title.text: Model Desk — four key moments of one request (worked example: SIPP transfer-out risk)

n1.text:
1 · Ask & frame
Intent: start from the decision, not the algorithm. Business questions that quietly set ML choices (horizon, call capacity → precision@K).
AI Elements: Conversation, Message, Reasoning (collapsed), Suggestion chips, Inline jargon tooltip, Prompt Input, Context.
Panel: live Model Brief + adjacent model + 'Tailored for you' memory card.

n2.text:
2 · Discover & plan
Intent: show the work as steps, cite sources, ask only at a boundary (confidential data).
AI Elements: Chain of Thought, Shimmer, Sources, Confirmation, Plan, Actions.
Panel: ontology entities → tables, base rate, fields excluded for leakage, baseline model.

n3.text:
3 · Train, evaluate, improve
Intent: failure is a diagnosis + next hypothesis, and the agent keeps going inside the agreed budget.
AI Elements: Checkpoint, Task, Tool (collapsed), Reasoning, Plan (diff), Queue (steering messages + experiments), Context (credits), Loader.
Panel: runs vs target, leaderboard, checkpoint timeline with restore / branch.

n4.text:
4 · Deliver
Intent: a model card the user can trust and share, explained at their level; background improvement is an explicit, budgeted offer.
AI Elements: Checkpoint, Artifact, Confirmation, Actions, Suggestion, Prompt Input.
Panel: model card. Toggle Plain / Practitioner / Expert to see memory-driven explanation levels.

v2title.text: Model Desk v2 — one column, one decision at a time, work collapses when done

v2n1.text:
1 · Ask
Frustrations answered: questions I can't answer (business-only, 'Not sure' default) · dead ends (feasibility check in seconds) · duplicates (existing model surfaced) · late governance surprise (prototype said up front).
Elements: Message, Reasoning (collapsed line), Suggestion → decision dock, Prompt Input.

v2n2.text:
2 · Working
Rule: only the active step is open. Reasoning, ontology search, SQL and Python stream in, then fold to one line with a result + duration. Click any line to reopen.
Long waits: honest time left + 'go, I'll message you on Teams'. Steering goes to a queue.
Elements: Chain of Thought, Reasoning, Tool, Code Block, Shimmer, Queue, Prompt Input.

v2n3.text:
3 · One decision
All approvals batched into one card: plan, success bar, budget and the confidential-data switch. One 'Start' click, then the agent runs on its own within this budget.
Elements: Chain of Thought (collapsed), Plan, Confirmation (inline switch), Actions.

v2n4.text:
4 · Not good enough yet
Shortfall in one line, three reasons, what changes next. Keeps going without asking. Progress-to-target track instead of a leaderboard. Queued steering visible.
Elements: Checkpoint, Task (collapsed), Plan diff (as prose), Loader, Queue.

v2n5.text:
5 · Result
One sentence + one chart. Main action is the thing they need ('Get this week's 500 clients'), not metrics. The model card opens in a drawer only when asked (shown open here).
Elements: Artifact (drawer), Actions, Confirmation (background toggle), Suggestion.

v3title.text: Model Desk v3 — agents, not chats: inbox on the left, the work in the middle, the plan on the right

v3n1.text:
1 · Home
Attention routing across many agents. Left = agent inbox grouped Needs you / Working / Live (not chat history). Simple decisions are made inline here without opening the agent. New requests start from the decision, and it checks what already exists first.

v3n2.text:
2 · Agent at work
Centre: activity stream; only the live step is open, finished steps fold to one line. Right: the agent's plan (its spine), outputs it has produced as openable objects, budget, and the autonomy setting. Header: process controls (pause / stop). Chat steers the plan rather than driving each step.
Composer: type / for commands (arrow keys + Enter), Shift+Tab cycles Ask before running → Auto within budget → Plan mode. 'Running as you' shows the Snowflake role, warehouse and sandbox.
Elements: Plan, Task, Queue, Chain of Thought, Tool, Code Block, Artifact, Context, Confirmation, Prompt Input (with command menu).

v3n4.text:
4 · Settings
Modelled on claude.ai settings: General, Memory, Agent behaviour (default mode + 'always ask' list, some locked by admin), Commands (yours + team), Snowflake and roles (SPCS: signed in via Snowflake, acts as your role; Model Desk app roles User / Approver / Admin), Budget and usage (monthly limit set by admin, per-request defaults), Notifications, Privacy and audit.

v3n5.text:
Composer spec
Static reference for the command menu and the three modes. Governance sits outside the modes: Confidential data and go-live always need approval, enforced by roles.

v3n3.text:
3 · Live model
Same three-pane shape, different job: the agent is a caretaker. Right panel = its standing orders (what it checks, how often, what it may do alone) and recent changes. Centre = health + its suggestions, each tagged by change size.

v2n6.text:
6 · Go live
A guided path, not a button: where the list goes, when, owners, a 2-week shadow run, auto-written review pack. Sets the maintenance policy up front: retrain on fresh data = pre-approved; new data = back to review.
Elements: Plan, Confirmation, Actions.

v2n7.text:
7 · Live model
Health in one sentence, honest about the 90-day outcome lag. Agent-raised suggestions, each tagged by how much change it means: setting / rule (instant), retrain (pre-approved, shadow-tested), new data (review). Challenger runs in shadow; one-click rollback. Chat tweaks become rules where possible.
Elements: Suggestion, Task, Confirmation, Checkpoint (history), Prompt Input.
